endings.narrative:
The cloaked warriors obey without question. They follow you beyond the gates of Highcastle to the infernal battlegrounds on the other side of the river, where you clash with the foreign invaders. The trained killers on your side have no trouble adapting to war. Having witnessed your martial prowess, they remain loyal and efficient, as you move from one violent skirmish to the next.
Days turn to nights as the western district keeps burning. The streets are crowded by rooks, crows and ravens. Beaks deep in carrion, the birds have flown from all corners of Tem Khiris, attracted by the rising pillars of smoke.
Each moment of rest is a blessing, leaving you with no room to ponder the future or the past. You are only concerned by two things: the death of your enemies, and the survival of those who are on your side. Nothing else. Thoughts drown in rivers of blood.
A cunning strategist, you earn the respect of noble knights and common infantry, as your deeds inspire fear in the hearts of the foreign soldiers.
As time goes on, your fearsome band of roving killers becomes known as the Dark Brigade, having played a crucial part in the liberation of Roeburgh. In spite of this, the quills of historians neglect your contributions to the war effort, restricting your fame to the vulgar margins of popular folklore.
When the war is over, only a few of those who fought by your side remains among the living. The last foreign warships vanish on the horizon, leaving you with scars and memories.
Once again, peace returns to the highlands. But there is no place for you on the Noble Heights, and the western district lies in ruins. Roaming the forest hills with your comrades, you are plagued by sleepless nights.
No longer able to seek refuge in the chaos of war, you are left with no other choice but to remember the many lives that were destroyed by the Khiris Cartel, including your own. You have slain Mantis, but other crime lords will take his place. Unseen forces are still at work in the shadows, laboring to profit from the exploitation of weakness and suffering.
You have grown strong, yet war has taken its toll.
Perhaps the remnants of your Dark Brigade will be a force of vengeance, determined to bring the crime lords to justice, once and for all. 
Or perhaps you will serve no higher purpose but your own survival, prowling the wilderness, preying upon those who are careless enough to step in your way. 
There’s no telling what the future holds.

When you wake up, your face is caressed by the wind of the forest. Carried on the shoulders of Avon Lorca, you find yourself deep in the wilderness of the western highlands, far from the city. Your many wounds are covered by strips of black cloth, stopping the flow of blood. The last thing you hear before you fall back asleep is the voice of Avon Lorca. The former gladiator says: "It's over."
You seek refuge in the realm of sleep, but your slumber is troubled by opposing forces. Nightmares of past tragedy and dreams of a future clouded by uncertainty. Whatever lies beyond the next horizon is not bound by any specific prophecy. The spring breeze inspires hope like a beacon of light on troubled waters.
Fate is a harsh mistress. Many of those who crossed your path have died for no good reason. You have nothing left in this world, it seems. Cold and numb, yet you are still among the living. But sorrow comes and goes. Your memories are nothing more than a burden. All things considered, the dead are left best left forgotten.
There’s no telling what the future holds.
Lacking martial prowess, you must rely on the strength of others. Men of war like Avon Lorca can be inspired to carry out your deeds, sharing a common goal in seeking retribution from the Khiris Cartel.
And yes, the crime lords can be defeated in more ways than one. Your words may expose their clandestine enterprise, eroding the foundation before it grows too strong. A well-placed whisper can place the opium barons behind bars, leaving them to rot away until their souls depart.
Soon, a new day will dawn on the western highlands, no longer plagued by war. You might find yourself occupied by a new way of life, concerned by matters far divorced from your bloodstained memories.

You leave the Sleep Temple behind, vowing to never return. Rejuvenated by the spring breeze, you gaze across the cloudy skies, wandering aimlessly through the orchards of Soma Gardens. Despite the fact that a war is raging beyond the walls of Highcastle, you feel safe and carefree. Regardless of what the future may hold, yours is a fate of uncertainty.
True, there is no escape from the smell of putrefaction, carried by the winds across the river. Perhaps your destiny lies on the other side of Hydran Bridge. Whatever the case may be, the war will come to an end, with or without you.
Somehow, you are at peace with yourself and your surroundings, knowing that the foreign army may cross the river and breach the gates of Highcastle. You have no fear, keeping your weapon close at hand.
Yet as time goes on, you can’t escape the burden of your memories.
Many lives were destroyed by the Khiris Cartel, including your own. You have slain Mantis, but other crime lords will take his place. 
You feel confident in your abilities, knowing that have you slain the worst of them all. When they learn about the fate of the praying Mantis, the other crime lords will tremble in fear. They will wait behind fortified gates of guarded compounds, knowing that a fabled nemesis keeps approaching, seemingly impervious to their weapons and machinations.
There’s no telling what the future holds. At this point in time, you can ask for no greater blessing.

You retire to the master bedroom, where you get some well-deserved rest. 
No one has the audacity to disturb your slumber. For the last time in your life, you are confronted by the souls of the fallen. 
Many of those who crossed your path have died for no good reason. Alone in bed, you close your eyes and remember their faces. One by one, they all burn in the Corridor of Flame. Soon enough, your memories are buried by dreams of what the future may hold. Sleeping like a child, your heart is now cold.
The next morning, you inspect the marble floor in the atrium. Eager to please, the Cartel enforcers have removed all traces of the praying Mantis. 
Satisfied, you assemble your subordinates and lay out the plans for the future. In the following years, your infamy spreads across the four corners of Tem Khiris. Feared and respected, you have earned your place as the unseen crime lord of the Noble Heights.
Yet others are biding their time, waiting for the right moment. As your wealth and influence grows, you keep your eyes open, knowing that one false move might lead to your downfall.

From this point on, your life is devoted to the Khiris Cartel.
Guided by the praying Mantis, you rise among the ranks of killers and scoundrels, until there is enough blood on your hands to earn you a reputation.
Years later, you find yourself in a distant land, perched on throne within a secluded mansion. Despite all the power and wealth that you have accumulated, you feel miserable and hollow.
Your heart is now cold, no longer burdened by the memories of your own tragedy. Yet your mind is crowded by the souls of the fallen. Always whispering, the phantoms linger in the back of your head, clouding your judgment.
The question remains. Did you come all this way by your own volition? Are you nothing more than a pawn, victimized by the affliction of the mind, leaving with you with no other choice but to victimize others?
There are times when you are tortured by these pointless ruminations, unable to break free from the shackles of doubt, as if your throne was a prison.
However, such thoughts are quickly dispersed by some distraction or other.
And in this moment, you hear footsteps approaching. Another fool darkens your doorstep, craving answers and retribution.

"Good dog." The world turns black as you slip out of consciousness. 
Time passes. You dream of the stingray. Slowly, the creature invades every nook and cranny of your mind, distorting your thoughts and memories beyond repair.
Your body is moved to the torture chamber, but your mind elsewhere, tantalized by the stingray and its dark influence.
Beyond numerous thresholds of pain, the affliction of the mind retains its dominion. For some time, your thoughts remain dormant within a battered husk.
When you awaken, you are nothing more than a beast of burden, eager to serve the praying Mantis, your lord and master.
Without question, you will obey his commands by your own volition. Enslaved by the Khiris Cartel, your blade is always guided by the voice of your master.
Unmarked and soon forgotten, a shallow grave waits at the end of your journey.

After a moment of hesitation, the swarm of cartel enforcers is rushing towards you, raising their weapons. 
The atrium becomes a stage for endless carnage. Fueled by adrenaline, you enter a frame of mind where the boundary between dream and reality is blurred.
You have returned to the killing fields…
Surrounded by violence and death, you remember each and every transgression, remaining determined to keep going until no one else in the room is still breathing.
No longer shackled by the affliction of the mind, you are now a beast of prey.
And the Khiris Cartel must reap what they have sown.
As time goes on, your mind is eroded by a different form of affliction. You are now consumed and driven by vengeful hatred.
The outcome remains to be seen. Outnumbered, you keep spilling their blood and entrails on the marble floor.
Only one thing is certain. Your personal crusade against the Khiris Cartel will continue until your soul burns in the Corridor of Flame.
